checks.explanation: In vitro gametogenesis (creating eggs from stem cells) has made scientific progress through the mid-2020s but remains experimental and not yet a routine fertility clinic offering, so the late-2020s mainstream availability predicted here has not yet materialized as of 2026, though the field continues advancing toward that possibility.

IVF has seen incremental improvements but has not yet become dramatically simpler or more widely available via lab-generated eggs by 2025-2026 as predicted; the core process remains largely as invasive and technically challenging as before.

No federal policy setting income tax to zero for earners under $150,000 was implemented; Trump's 2025 tax legislation (the 'One Big Beautiful Bill') included various tax cuts and a 'no tax on tips/overtime' provision but did not zero out income taxes for that income bracket.

The US housing market did not experience a major crash or trillions in value wiped out following the 2022 equity downturn; home prices remained resilient and even continued rising in most markets through 2023-2025 due to persistently low housing supply.
US home prices did not decline 30-40%; national home price indices continued rising modestly through 2023-2025 rather than experiencing the predicted major correction.

The Social Security Trust Fund's projected insolvency date remains in the future (still projected for the early-to-mid 2030s as of the latest Trustees' reports), so this cannot yet be conclusively verified.
Jason Calacanis has not run for US president, so this conditional prediction has not been triggered or tested.

The S&P 500 did post strong gains in various periods after 2024, and cultural attention to transgender-related political controversies has fluctuated, but there is no clean, verifiable causal link demonstrating that market gains specifically displaced bathroom-related political salience in the way described.

Elon Musk did not maintain a consistently cooperative posture with Trump throughout the 2025-2029 term; the two had a highly public and acrimonious falling out in mid-2025 after Musk left the administration, with Musk publicly criticizing Trump's spending bill and Trump threatening to cut Musk's government contracts.
There is no publicly available information confirming whether Andrew Schulz has had additional children since this 2024 episode.
